q: What does this traffic sign means?
imageDesc: Red triangular warning sign with red, yellow and green traffic light symbols inside
info: Red triangular signs are warning signs (LTO). This one warns traffic lights are ahead, so slow down and prepare to stop.

q: A driver while on a highway shall yield the right-of-way to:
B: pedestrians crossing at an intersection where the movement of traffic is being regulated by a traffic enforcer
C: vehicles about to enter the highway
info: RA 4136 gives pedestrians crossing within a crosswalk the right-of-way, so highway drivers must yield unless an officer or signal controls movement.

q: Among the list, who are exempted from speed limits?
B: Doctors or their drivers going to an emergency
C: Drivers of high ranking officials of the government
info: RA 4136 exempts genuine emergencies such as a doctor rushing to an emergency; evading arrest or rank alone is not an exemption.

q: When do you need to switch on your turn signal?
info: Signal before turning (LTO defensive driving) to warn others in advance; signaling after or while turning is too late.

q: What sign will constitute an offense if it will be disregarded?
info: Regulatory signs - round, inverted-triangle, octagonal with red border - impose legal orders under RA 4136, so ignoring one is an offense.

q: A flashing green light means:
C: slow down and be ready to stop where a pedestrian cross the street
info: A flashing green means you may proceed but with caution (LTO CDE), watching pedestrians and conflicting traffic first.

q: A pedestrian runs across the street when you are about to move off from a red light. What should you do?
A: Blow horn once and allow the pedestrian to cross
C: Expect the pedestrian to walk back
info: Pedestrian safety prevails: wait until the pedestrian has crossed before moving off, even on your go signal, to avoid a crash.

q: What is the meaning of this traffic light?
B: Stop if the red light comes
imageDesc: Vertical traffic light with the middle yellow light illuminated
info: Yellow/amber means prepare to stop (LTO/RA 4136); red comes next, so slow down and stop unless unsafe.

q: You are planning a long trip. Do you need to plan rest stops?
A: No, you will arrive to your destination faster
B: No, only fuel stops will be needed
C: Yes, regular stops help avoid mental and physical fatigue
info: LTO CDE fatigue rule: take regular rest stops on long trips because fatigue slows reaction and risks falling asleep.

q: During period of illness, your ability to drive may be impaired. You must:
A: only take smaller doses of any medicine at all times to ensure safety
B: see your doctor each time before you drive, especially for long trips
C: be physically and mentally fit and do not drive after taking medicine
info: LTO CDE requires drivers be physically and mentally fit; illness and medicine impair ability, so do not drive after medication.

q: Under R.A. 10666 also known as Children's Safety on Motorcycle Act, the child must grasp the rider's waist, can step and rest his/her feet comfortably on the foot peg, and ________________.
A: he/she must be at least five (5) feet in height
B: he/she must wear standard protective helmet
info: RA 10666 Children's Safety on Motorcycles Act requires the child to grasp the waist, reach foot pegs, and wear a standard protective helmet.

q: What is the maximum penalty for driving under the influence of liquor or prohibited drugs?
info: Driving under liquor or drugs carries the heaviest penalty - perpetual license revocation - because of its grave danger (RA 10586).

q: If the brake light of the vehicle in front of you lights up, you should:
info: Brake lights mean the vehicle ahead is slowing or stopping; prepare to brake early to keep safe following distance.

q: The primary objective of looking ahead while driving is:
A: to check for the presence of traffic enforcers
B: to check the traffic ahead and changes of road condition
info: Looking ahead lets you spot traffic and road-condition changes early so you can react in time (defensive driving).

q: What does this traffic sign means?
imageDesc: Red triangular warning sign with black arrow curving to the right
info: Red triangle means warning sign (LTO); the right-curving arrow warns of a dangerous right curve ahead, so slow down.

q: What should the driver do if he/she is already within the intersection when the yellow traffic light comes?
A: Slow down to allow other vehicles to cross
C: The driver may continue driving with caution
info: If already inside when yellow appears, continue with caution and clear the intersection; sudden stopping inside blocks traffic.

q: Why are rumble strips installed across the road?
A: To help you keep the correct separation distance
B: To help you choose the correct lane
C: To make you alert and aware of your speed
info: Rumble strips vibrate to alert you and make you aware of speed, usually before hazards, intersections, or slow zones.

q: Which one is a mandate of LTO?
B: Register roadworthy and emission complaint motor vehicles
info: LTO's mandate is to register roadworthy, emission-compliant motor vehicles; CPC/franchises belong to LTFRB, not LTO.

q: A blinking yellow traffic light means?
A: Slow down and proceed if there is no danger
C: Stop and wait for the traffic light to change
info: Blinking yellow means slow down and proceed only if safe (LTO); it warns of hazard but needs no full stop like red.

q: When do you need to check your engine oil level?
info: Check oil when the engine is cold so oil has settled for an accurate reading and you avoid burns from hot parts.

q: Yellow box pavement marking is painted within intersections where no vehicle is allowed to __________ .
info: Yellow box keeps the intersection clear; stopping inside blocks cross traffic and causes gridlock. Never stop inside it per LTO rules.

q: What comes next after this traffic light?
imageDesc: Vertical traffic signal with the middle yellow/amber light illuminated
info: Signals run green-yellow/amber-red. Yellow means prepare to stop because red comes next (LTO CDE).

q: How can you avoid wasting fuel?
A: By filling up the saddle and top box
B: By servicing your vehicle less regularly
C: By having your vehicle properly serviced and maintained
info: A tuned engine, correct tire pressure and clean filters burn fuel efficiently. Poor maintenance wastes fuel and raises emissions.

q: What does this traffic sign means?
C: No entry for all types of vehicles
imageDesc: Red octagonal sign with white text STOP
info: The red octagonal STOP is a regulatory sign under RA 4136. You must stop fully, then yield before proceeding.

q: In case a road crash involving physical injury, the first duty of the involved driver is:
A: attend to the injured person and call for help
B: report the incident to a hospital
C: report the incident to the nearest police station
info: Life comes first: attend the injured and call for help before reporting. Required by RA 4136 duties after a crash.

q: When a driver sees the yellow light signal changes to red, a vehicle is already in the intersection to turn left or right may __________ .
A: slow down to allow other vehicles to proceed
C: continue to proceed through the intersection even if the light on the signal to the left / right is red
info: Stopping inside the intersection is more dangerous and blocks traffic. Clear it with caution even if the light turns red.

q: Motorcycle riders must exercise safety and care at all times. To do so, they are required to wear:
info: Only standard protective helmets absorb impact and meet PH standards. Construction helmets or caps give no crash protection (LTO CDE).

q: Where would you see this sign?
A: At the side of the road
imageDesc: Circular yellow sign with black silhouettes of an adult and a child walking
info: The yellow circle with adult and child warns of a school crossing ahead. Slow down and yield to pedestrians.

q: What does this traffic sign means?
imageDesc: Red circle with diagonal red slash over black motorcycle/rider silhouette
info: The red prohibitory circle with a motorcycle means no motorcycles allowed. It is a regulatory sign that must be obeyed (RA 4136).

q: How does alcohol affect you?
info: Alcohol impairs judgment, reaction and concentration, raising crash risk. Never drive after drinking (LTO CDE).

q: What is the meaning of “beating the red light”?
A: Driving faster upon seeing a yellow/amber light
info: Yellow/amber means prepare to stop, not speed up. Accelerating to beat the red causes intersection crashes.

q: Under R.A. 10666, which of the following prohibits the rider to convey a child?
A: Where a speed limit of more than 40 kph is imposed
B: Where a speed limit of more than 50 kph is imposed
C: Where a speed limit of more than 60 kph is imposed
info: RA 10666 bans a child passenger where the speed limit exceeds 60 kph. High speeds make motorcycle crashes far deadlier for children.

q: What should you do whenever you are driving on a highway with a lot of potholes?
info: Slowing keeps tire grip and control and avoids rim, tire and suspension damage. Hitting potholes fast can cause loss of control.

q: You service your own vehicle. How should you get rid of the old engine oil?
A: Tip it into a hole in the ground
C: Put it into your dust bin
info: Used oil is toxic and pollutes soil and water. Collect it and bring it to a proper disposal or recycling facility.

q: What is the maximum and allowable width of the saddle box or bag?
info: LTO limits saddle boxes to 14 inches per side. Wider loads unbalance the bike and can sideswipe other road users.

q: When more than one driver arrived at a four-way stop, who has the right-of-way?
A: The driver who arrived first should be the first to go
B: The last driver to arrive should be the first to go
C: The driver of the larger vehicle should be the first to go
info: First to arrive goes first so all drivers take turns safely. This prevents confusion and right-of-way crashes.

q: How much is the imposed fine and penalty for the first offense if you violate the R.A. 10666 on Safety of Children Aboard Motorcycle?
info: RA 10666 sets P3,000 for the first offense of carrying a child unsafely on a motorcycle. Penalties rise to P5,000 then P10,000.

q: What does this traffic sign means?
C: No entry on all types of vehicles
imageDesc: Red prohibitory circle with diagonal slash showing two cars side by side - red car on left and black car on right
info: The circle with two cars means no overtaking; it is a regulatory sign. Overtaking there risks head-on collision (RA 4136).

q: Which of the traffic lights requires you to prepare for a stop?
info: Yellow/amber warns the signal is turning red. Ease off and prepare to stop unless unsafe to do so (LTO CDE).

q: A blue traffic light means:
C: None, there are no blue traffic lights
info: PH signals use only red, yellow/amber and green. Blue is not used, so the correct CDE answer is none exist.

q: You are entering an area of roadworks where there is a temporary “No Overtaking” sign. You must:
A: obey the sign only during rush hour
C: obey only when a traffic enforcer is on duty
info: Temporary roadwork signs have full authority under RA 4136. Obey the No Overtaking sign because narrowed lanes and workers make passing dangerous.

q: Using a backbone motorcycle, which stand do you need to use when parking overnight?
info: Use the center stand for overnight parking because it holds the bike upright and stable. It prevents tip-over unlike the side stand.

q: Ahead of you is a vehicle with a flashing yellow light. This means it is:
info: A flashing yellow light marks a slow-moving or service vehicle. Slow down and pass with caution per LTO defensive-driving rules.

q: What should you do if the road is wet?
info: Slow down on wet roads because traction drops and stopping distance grows. This prevents skids from improper braking per LTO CDE.

q: It is the car's turn and brake signals have failed, so the driver is using hand gestures to signal instead. What is the driver's intention?
imageDesc: Diagram of a driver's left arm extended out of car window bent upward at the elbow with palm facing forward
info: A left arm bent upward at the elbow signals a right turn under RA 4136 hand signals. It warns others when brake and turn signals have failed.

q: You approach an intersection with malfunctioning traffic signals. What should you do?
A: Treat the intersection as if there were “Stop” signs in all directions
B: Increase your speed because the intersection is clear
C: Slow down and wait for a traffic enforcer
info: Treat dead signals as an all-way stop per RA 4136 right-of-way rules. Stop, yield by arrival order, and go only when clear.

q: If you encounter emergency vehicles such as an ambulance, a fire truck and police cars on the road with sirens on, what should you do?
A: Ignore them since you have no business interfering with their jobs
B: Give way by pulling in to the left or right side of the road depending on the circumstances
C: Obstruct their passage and never allow them to pass through
info: Pull to the side and give way because emergency vehicles on siren have priority under RA 4136. Never block or crowd them.

q: What is the authority granted by LTO to a person who desires to learn to operate a motor vehicle valid for a period of one year?
info: A Student Driver's Permit is the 1-year learning authority granted by LTO. It allows practice only under supervision of a licensed driver.

q: How much is the penalty for the second offenses of R.A. 10666 Children's Safety on Motorcycle Act of 2015?
info: RA 10666 Children's Safety on Motorcycles sets a P5,000 fine for the 2nd offense. It deters carrying small children unsafely.

q: What should you do when you approach a roadwork with a temporary maximum speed limit sign?
A: Comply with the sign at all times
B: Comply with the sign during the day
C: Comply with the sign when the lanes are narrow
info: Comply with temporary work-zone speed limits at all times. They protect workers in narrowed zones and carry force under RA 4136.

q: A “No Parking” sign means:
A: a motorist can park provided that he/she is driving a private vehicle
B: a motorist cannot do a temporary stop otherwise he/she will be apprehended for disregarding traffic sign
C: a motorist can make a temporary stop, within a reasonable time to load or unload but must not obstruct other vehicles
info: No Parking still allows a brief stop to load or unload if you do not obstruct others. It only bans prolonged parking per RA 4136.

q: What does this traffic sign means?
imageDesc: Red-bordered triangular warning sign with black winding double-curve arrow
info: The red-bordered triangular sign warns of dangerous curves ahead. Slow down and stay in lane because sharp bends reduce control.

q: When is it legal to use the shoulder of a road when overtaking another vehicle?
A: When the vehicle in front of you is making a right turn
B: When the vehicle in front of you is visibly signaling to make a left turn
C: During normal circumstances, you are not legally allowed to pass using the shoulder of road
info: Overtaking on the shoulder is illegal in normal circumstances under RA 4136. Shoulders are for emergencies, not passing.

q: This action can cause you to skid and lose control when you make an abrupt move especially on a wet and possibly slippery road.
info: Improper or abrupt braking causes skids and loss of control, especially when wet. Brake smoothly per LTO CDE guidance.

q: To help reduce air pollution using your brake, what should you do?
info: Brake properly and smoothly to cut fuel waste and air pollution. Sudden, frequent braking burns extra fuel and wears brakes.

q: Signs that are round, inverted triangle or octagonal and with red colored border are called:
info: Round, inverted-triangle, and octagonal signs with red borders are regulatory per LTO. Disobeying them violates RA 4136.

q: You arrive at a crossroad. You want to turn left, and you have a green arrow light. Can you proceed?
A: Yes, you can turn left, as this is a “protected” turn where no other cars are allowed to enter the intersection
B: No, you cannot turn left unless you have a green left pointing arrow
C: Yes, you can turn left, however you may still need to yield to pedestrians and incoming traffic
info: Yes, a green arrow is a protected turn where conflicting traffic is stopped. Proceed but still watch for pedestrians.

q: What should be done first before changing lanes?
info: Signal first before changing lanes so others know your intent under RA 4136. Then check mirrors and blind spots before moving.

q: What does this traffic sign means?
imageDesc: Square sign with black U-turn arrow crossed by red circle and diagonal slash
info: The red-slashed U-turn sign is a regulatory sign banning U-turns. Obey it because U-turns there endanger traffic flow per RA 4136.

q: You should not use a mobile phone while riding a motorcycle because:
A: reception is poor when the engine is running
B: it will affect your vehicle’s electronic system
C: it is prohibited by law and it distracts your attention while driving
info: Do not use a mobile phone while riding because it is prohibited by law and distracts attention. Distraction causes crashes per LTO CDE.
